create_SyntheticShapes: create a SyntheticShapes dataset with custom height, width, and drawing primitives for generating synthetic images
generate_SyntheticShapes_item: generate a synthetic image with associated keypoint positions from a SyntheticShapes dataset iterator
parse_SyntheticShapes_primitives: parse a string or list of drawing primitive names into a validated tuple of primitive identifiers
build_SyntheticShapes_background: build a synthetic background image with configurable kernel size and radial ratio parameters
resize_SyntheticShapes_image_points: resize a synthetic image and its associated keypoint positions to target dimensions
